raw.title: Bhedabheda
raw.extract: Bhedābheda refers to a tradition in Vedānta that teaches that the individual self (jīvātman) is both different (bheda) and not different (abheda) from Brahman. It encompasses sub-schools such as Shuddhadvaita and Acintya-Bhedabheda.
